editorial:
Imagine you are driving from LA to New York for work, feeling totally in control of your life, and then you make the mistake of picking up two hitchhikers. That is exactly how things go south for the lead character in this tense thriller. You get to watch a successful ad executive lose everything in an instant when these guys steal her car and leave her for dead. The vibe is very gritty and stressful because she goes from being a high-flyer to a terrified prisoner in a tiny town. It feels like a nightmare where every time she tries to fix things, the situation gets even worse.

What really works here is the suspense and the way the story keeps you guessing about who to trust. The acting is solid, and the action scenes feel real and scary rather than fake. While it is an older TV movie and the quality is not modern, the plot moves fast enough that you will not mind. If you like stories about survival and fighting the system, you should definitely check this out.
endingExplained: In the final act, the main character manages to stay one step ahead of the law while trying to prove she was framed. The big payoff happens when she finally forces the hitchhiker to admit the truth about the crimes. After a tense standoff, the real villains are exposed and the police finally realize she acted in self-defense. She is cleared of all charges and gets her freedom back, though she is forever changed by the trauma.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves old-school crime thrillers and survival stories.
